summary: Acura Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K reporting a $200,000 loan from Abuse Deterrent Pharma, LLC (AD Pharma), increasing the secured promissory note principal to ~$10.9M with ~$1.2M accrued interest at 5.25%. Default triggers include bankruptcy, non-payment after 5 days, or inability to pay debts; overdue amounts bear 7.5% interest. Proceeds fund day-to-day operations; management warns that without additional financing by mid-August 2026, it may furlough employees, terminate operations, or seek bankruptcy protection, potentially wiping out shareholder value. This is a routine going-concern disclosure, not a special situation. Watch for further liquidity events.
